item.title: FBI investigating after hackers say they took sensitive data from agency's jobs site
item.description: The FBI is investigating criminal hackers' claims of breaching its jobs website. The apparent hack poses a potential counterintelligence risk and a safety concern for employees and applicants.
item.content:encoded: The FBI is investigating criminal hackers' claims of breaching its jobs website. The apparent hack poses a potential counterintelligence risk and a safety concern for employees and applicants.
item.dc:creator: Ryan Lucas

item.title: The Education Dept. hasn't been dismantled. It's become more inefficient, staff say
item.description: Education staff are being scattered across several other federal agencies. Despite the Trump administration's claims, employees say it's adding bureaucracy and making it harder to serve students.
item.content:encoded:
Education staff are being scattered across several other federal agencies. Despite the Trump administration's claims, employees say it's adding bureaucracy and making it harder to serve students.

item.title: Could the White House try its press ban again? A press freedom expert explains
item.description: A federal judge's ruling restored CNN, MS Now and Politico's access to the White House. Gabe Rottman says better procedure alone may not resolve the broader First Amendment fight.

item.title: For their podcast, 2 elementary school students ask adults why they chose their jobs
item.description: Kids are used to being asked, "What do you want to be when you grow up?" Two students in Columbus, Ohio, flipped the script to ask grown-ups why they chose their careers.

item.title: Judge orders Trump administration to restore journalists' access to White House
item.description: A federal judge ordered the Trump administration on Thursday to temporarily restore access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico, after they were banned from covering White House events by President Trump.

item.title: From cybersecurity to AI to Taiwan, what's at stake in Trump's summit with Xi
item.description: As President Trump and China's President Xi prepare to meet, Rush Doshi of the Council on Foreign Relations explains the current state of U.S.-China relations and what to expect from this summit.
